provenance: 本文件是本课题自撰的固定演示语料：题名、作者、年份、摘要与逐页正文均为演示用合成内容，不代表任何真实论文，也不得作为检索质量或领域覆盖证据。记录标识统一使用 demo- 前缀，避免与真实 arXiv 编号或 DOI 混淆。所有记录都不声明开放全文位置，因此演示会真实走到“获取开放全文失败 → 附加本地全文”这条既有回退路径。

demo.question: What evaluation protocol do the demo papers use for evidence checking?

records.title: Demo Paper A: Page-Aware Evidence for Retrieval-Augmented Answers
records.abstract: 演示用合成摘要：讨论按页切块与坐标派生引文对回答可核验性的影响。
pages: Demo paper A page one. The study splits every document by page so that no retrieval chunk crosses a page boundary, and it derives each quote from stored character coordinates instead of accepting text from the caller.
Demo paper A page two. The evaluation protocol compares every rendered claim against the stored page text and reports an explicit failure when a coordinate no longer matches the hashed document.

records.title: Demo Paper B: Scoped Retrieval Inside a Single Research Project
records.abstract: 演示用合成摘要：讨论项目与文献双范围检索如何避免无范围回答。
pages: Demo paper B page one. Retrieval is restricted to one project root and to the identifiers the user selected, so a global index can never contribute evidence to a project answer.
Demo paper B page two. The evaluation protocol repeats each question with an empty scope and expects an explicit refusal rather than a best-effort answer.

records.title: Demo Paper C: A Record Without Any Open Full Text
records.abstract: 演示用合成摘要：该记录保留元数据但没有全文，用于演示 access_unavailable 与后续的显式跳过。
pages: Demo paper C page one. This synthetic record deliberately has no full text attached, so the demo records a skipped index step instead of pretending that a missing document was parsed.
Demo paper C page two. Nothing here may be presented as an online retrieval result.
